en.calculator_meta_description: Free SAB trading values calculator for Steal a Brainrot. Compare Brainrot trade value side by side, check W/F/L results, and calculate income with mutations and traits.
en.calculator_intro: Check SAB trading values and compare Brainrot trade value with mutations, traits, income and W/F/L before you accept.
en.calculator_compare_both_empty: Add items to both sides to check W/F/L.
en.calculator_compare_need_receive: Add items to You Receive to compare the trade.
en.calculator_compare_need_offer: Add items to Your Offer to compare the trade.
en.calculator_income_check_body: Trait income multipliers stack additively with the mutation multiplier. Traits with a multiplier below 1x are applied multiplicatively after the sum.
en.calculator_value_check_body: Each trait adds a percentage bonus to the mutation value. Bonuses stack additively and are multiplied by the streak bonus when 3 or 6 traits are selected.
en.calculator_trait_bonus_empty: Trait bonus data will appear after calculator sync.
en.calculator_seo_title: How to Use the SAB Calculator
calculator_seo_steps: Add the Brainrots you are offering.
Add the Brainrots you want to receive.
Select the correct mutation for each Brainrot.
Add traits if the Brainrot has any.
Compare total value and income to see whether the trade is a win, fair trade or lose.
en.calculator_values_body: SAB trading values are estimated player-to-player references for Steal a Brainrot items. Values can move when rarity, demand, income, mutations, traits or exist count change. Use them as a trading guide, then compare both sides again before accepting a deal.
en.calculator_wfl_title: How to Check W/F/L in Steal a Brainrot
en.calculator_wfl_body: W/F/L means Win, Fair or Lose. A win trade means the Brainrots you receive are estimated to be worth more than your offer. A fair trade means both sides are close in value. A lose trade means your offer may be worth more than what you receive.
en.calculator_mutations_title: How Mutations and Traits Affect SAB Trade Value
en.calculator_mutations_body: Mutations and traits can greatly change a Brainrot trade value. A rare mutation may increase income, demand and estimated value. Traits can also add extra bonuses, especially when several traits are selected together.
en.calculator_exist_count_title: Why Exist Count Matters in SAB Trading
en.calculator_exist_count_body: Exist count is an important signal when checking rare Brainrots. A lower exist count usually means fewer copies are available, which can make the Brainrot more desirable in trades.

en.calculator_value_list_link: View Steal a Brainrot Value List
calculator_tips: Check both value and income before trading.
Do not judge rare Brainrots only by name.
Compare low exist count Brainrots carefully.
Recheck values after major game updates.
Be careful with trades that look too good to be true.
en.calculator_popular_title: Popular Brainrots to Check Before Trading
en.calculator_popular_body: Popular and rare Brainrots are worth checking carefully because small differences in mutations, traits, income or exist count can affect their SAB trading values.
calculator_faq_items: What is a SAB trading values calculator?
It is a free Steal a Brainrot trading calculator that compares SAB trading values on both sides of a trade, including income, mutations, traits and the W/F/L result, before you accept.
How do I check Brainrot trade value before trading?
Add the Brainrots on both sides of the trade, choose the correct mutation and traits, then compare total value, income and the W/F/L result.
What does W/F/L mean in SAB trading?
W/F/L means Win, Fair or Lose. It helps players understand whether the Brainrots they receive are worth more than, close to or less than the Brainrots they offer.
Do mutations and traits change trade value?
Yes. Mutations and traits can change income and estimated trade value, so two Brainrots with the same name may have different results.
No. SAB trading values are player-to-player references, not official prices. Use them as a guide and recheck demand, exist count, mutations and traits before trading.
Is this Steal a Brainrot trading calculator free?
Yes. The SABExistCount trading calculator is free to use and helps players compare SAB trading values before accepting a trade.
